title: lamina codes.json v2
description: The one list of lamina's error and warning codes (ADR 0003 §2, ADR 0026 §3). `cargo xtask gen codes` validates fixtures/codes.json against this schema before it generates anything; crates/lamina-cos/tests/codes.rs checks the rest (pages, unique codes, the Rust enums).

docsUrl.description: docsUrl = base + code + suffix (ADR 0026 §6): one constant for every surface.

limits.description: The names of the Limits fields (ADR 0003 §3), in declaration order: data.limit of limit-exceeded.

group.description: One group of codes. Keys ending in Warnings (or `warnings`) list warnings; the others list errors.

summary.description: One lowercase sentence without a trailing period: what happened. A warning's message.

hint.description: One actionable sentence without a trailing period (ADR 0026 §5). Fixed text; the only parameters are {limit} and {option}.

since.description: The version that added the code.

retired.description: The version that retired the code; it stays listed and keeps its page (ADR 0026 §3).

kind.description: The nine kinds of ADR 0026 §2: a closed set.
